basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 25.' and it opens 'Vers. 25. Locus spatiosus ad manendum. Locus spatiosus ad manendum quem Rebecca apud se'. The printing's caput and the lemma's own words, matched against the Clementine, name the same chapter.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 25. Locus spatiosus ad manendum. Locus spatiosus ad manendum quem Rebecca apud se esse dicit lex est naturalis quam sancta Ecclesia, antequam ad Christum veniret, habebat, qua dicitur: Quaecunque vultis ut faciant vobis homines, eadem et vos facite illis (Matth. VII 12). Ergo per hanc legem naturae praeparabatur ingressus legi evangelicae.
